item.title: Festive Yorkshire puds & more now available at top-notch Hull takeaway
item.description: If you’re after something a bit wild this festive season, then check out Top Dawgs Streetfood on Southcoates Lane. item.title: Friendly little chippy on Beverley Road run by Hull lass with 20 years of experience
item.description: Hull lass Lucy spent two decades mastering proper fish and chips before finally opening her own shop in 2024. item.title: Neurodiverse and Care Experienced Christmas Exhibition at the Guildhall
item.description: Hull City Council’s Making Changes for Careers (MC4C) programme is proud to announce that the Neurodiverse and Care Experienced Christmas Exhibition is taking place at the Guildhall on Friday 12th December 2025.
